title: E-QTM-0080: topological protection of the edge-mode count: the number of interface edge modes between two gapped...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0080 in the quantum arena: topological protection of the edge-mode count: the number of interface edge modes between two gapped phases of different winding (W=+2 next to W=-2) is invariant (exactly 8) under a sharp step, smooth interfaces of width 2/3/4, and a deterministic ripple on the coin angles, while the trivial phase carrying the same ripple binds exactly zero, so the count cannot be removed by any smooth gap-preserving deformation.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
